config.lava_boat_clutch.title: Lava Boat Clutch Fix Settings
config.lava_boat_clutch.enable_mod.toolt: Doth enable or disable the lava boat clutch mechanic.
config.lava_boat_clutch.immunity_ticks.t: The number of ticks in which the boat doth not burn in the lava.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_mode:
Default: doth use vanilla velocity
Custom: doth use configurable velocity.
Random: uses random velocity.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_y.to: Upward velocity applied to the boat's drop after the boat doth burn in lava.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_x.to: Lateral velocity along the X axis applied to the boat's drop after the boat doth burn in lava.
config.lava_boat_clutch.bounce_drop_z.to: Lateral velocity along the Z axis applied to the boat's drop after the boat doth burn in lava.
